reason: Provides natural-language reference image search across Openverse, Pexels, Pixabay, and Unsplash, with inline visual results, paging, downloads, and optional Eagle integration.

summaries.zh: 通过自然语言搜索多个图片提供商的参考图，并在聊天中以可视化墙展示结果，支持翻页、下载和可选的 Eagle 保存。
summaries.en: Searches multiple image providers for visual references from natural-language queries and displays results in chat with paging, downloads, and optional Eagle saving.

capabilities: Searches image providers through documented APIs
Renders image results in the chat interface
Downloads selected images through a host proxy route
Sends image URLs and metadata to a local Eagle app when configured
